title: Ava reveals landlord troubles

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Have you paid this months rent?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you paid this months rent?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am not sure. But I notice your current residence has an outstanding eviction notice. Indeed, potential tenants are already scheduled to view your apartment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not sure. But I notice your current residence has an outstanding eviction notice. Indeed, potential tenants are already scheduled to view your apartment.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I recommend you meet with your landlord and get to the bottom of this. As the Comms are down, simply calling him is impossible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I recommend you meet with your landlord and get to the bottom of this. As the Comms are down, simply calling him is impossible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I inherited this flat. Who is the landlord?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I inherited this flat. Who is the landlord?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I inherited this flat. Who is the landlord?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I inherited this flat. Who is the landlord?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: My records show this flat is owned by a certain Mr Pilk Dane.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My records show this flat is owned by a certain Mr Pilk Dane.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'll add a Nav Point. It seems he wants to talk with you too...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll add a Nav Point. It seems he wants to talk with you too...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Might I advise caution in this endeavor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Might I advise caution in this endeavor.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The situation with accommodation in Nivalis is... precarious. Losing your property at this time could lead to homelessness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The situation with accommodation in Nivalis is... precarious. Losing your property at this time could lead to homelessness.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hyper-gentrification has led to extreme housing shortages. The LUZ has made the situation considerably worse.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hyper-gentrification has led to extreme housing shortages. The LUZ has made the situation considerably worse.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aren't people RUNNING AWAY FROM the serial killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aren't people RUNNING AWAY FROM the serial killer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aren't people RUNNING AWAY FROM the serial killer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aren't people RUNNING AWAY FROM the serial killer?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. Quite the opposite. Leaving the LUZ is forbidden, but a considerable number of tourists and opportunists are sneaking INTO the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Quite the opposite. Leaving the LUZ is forbidden, but a considerable number of tourists and opportunists are sneaking INTO the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Crisis breeds opportunity. And curiosity. There are Aseptic T-shirt sellers, Aseptic Walking Tours, Aseptic Murder Experiences... and of course some people just want to be where the stories are happening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crisis breeds opportunity. And curiosity. There are Aseptic T-shirt sellers, Aseptic Walking Tours, Aseptic Murder Experiences... and of course some people just want to be where the stories are happening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess that's just good business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that's just good business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess that's just good business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess that's just good business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess this is where the best parties are now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess this is where the best parties are now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess this is where the best parties are now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess this is where the best parties are now.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, I say sneaking... but really they are simply paying a fee and signing a waiver that "death may occur" within the quarantine zone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I say sneaking... but really they are simply paying a fee and signing a waiver that "death may occur" within the quarantine zone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like trouble. Where can I find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like trouble. Where can I find him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like trouble. Where can I find him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like trouble. Where can I find him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then I hope he's not the type to hold a grudge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I hope he's not the type to hold a grudge.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then I hope he's not the type to hold a grudge.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then I hope he's not the type to hold a grudge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long will they keep up the LUZ, now that we found the killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long will they keep up the LUZ, now that we found the killer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long will they keep up the LUZ, now that we found the killer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long will they keep up the LUZ, now that we found the killer?
